event.title: Vinyl Nights at Higher Gravity Northside
event.description:
Join us every Monday for Vinyl Nights at Higher Gravity Northside.  We will be open from 4:00 – 10:00 PM with some great drink specials and Adam will be here with a record player to play all your favorite records.

Drink specials include:

  • $2 off all craft beer cans / bottles
  • $1 off all domestic beer cans

How will Vinyl night work?

  • Just bring in your favorite record, or a new record (our friends at Shake it Records would love it if you grabbed some new Vinyl on your way down) and Adam will play it
  • Records will be player first-come, first served
  • Depending on the number of records brought in, Adam will play a few songs from each, or he may play a whole album.  This will just depend on the crowd and the vibe everyone is feeling.

Subscribe to our Facebook event page for more info.

event.title: Grupo Tan Tan
event.description:
Experience the roots of conjunto music in its purest form.

Grupo Tan Tan (AKA Los Callejeros) returns to Sanchos Cantina & Cocina for a series of shows highlighting the home grown sounds of classic conjunto music in the breeding grounds of a neighborhood cantina.

True to the origins of conjunto music Grupo Tan Tan will be playing classic conjunto songs as a trio with the use of accordion, bajosexto, and tololoche.

Song lists will include popular polkas, waltzes, huapangos, rancheras, and cumbias by trailblazers and founders of the conjunto genre like Flaco Jimenez, Tony de la Rosa, Nicky Snick Villarreal, Santiago Jimenez, and Steve Jordan.

The group will also dive into classic and contemporary norteño, county, oldies, and cumbias that formed the sounds native to San Antonio. These songs will include artists such as Grupo Frontera, Los Tigres de Norte, Vicente Fernandez, Los Tucanes, Ramon Ayala, Anecito Molina, and Johnny Cash.

This series of shows is the type of event that anyone who is a lover of culture should not miss and we encourage everyone to bring friends and family as we hope these type of events will help foster a growing appreciation for our unique San Antonio culture.

See you on the dance floor!

event.title: Getting Started with Genealogy – AM
event.description:
Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.
